name: Cooperative Rend [Combat, Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
You and an ally each sink a claw into your foe—then all you have to do is pull.

Prerequisite(s): Rend, troll.

Benefit(s): Whenever you and an ally are both threatening the same creature, you must hit the target with at least one of your claw attacks for your ally to use their rend ability.

Normal: You and your ally must hit with two of your claw attacks to use your respective rend abilities.
